summary: Fixed go.mod (go 1.19, no toolchain line), re-vendored csvq v1.6.0 via go mod tidy/vendor, corrected the Makefile (module path, -trimpath, -buildvcs=false, CGO off, first line of VERSION), embedded the _base.csv table with tables/*.csv, added the unix build constraint to progress_unix.go, and fixed the unknown-region warning to quote the region. make test passes, five release targets build, and binaries are byte-identical across directories.
